title: Fourier coefficients under global sign reversal
statement: For every natural number $n$, every real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and every coordinate set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the function $x\mapsto f(-x)$ equals $(-1)^{|S|}$ times the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube
